description: Status of a Dropscan sync started by sync_dropscan. Without job_id returns the most recent run. Returns { state: 'running'|'completed'|'failed', seen, created, updated, scans_stored, content_fetched, content_failed, deadlines_found, remaining_without_content, failures[], started_at, finished_at }. remaining_without_content > 0 means a backfill should call sync_dropscan again.
name: get_dropscan_sync_status
